name: EPIC 212619281
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 9.5 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,030 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.94 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,611 K at its surface.
